title: Proving olympiad geometry theorems on a superconducting quantum processor
abstract: arXiv:2609.14533v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automated theorem proving seeks to use computational systems to prove or disprove mathematical and logical statements [1, 2]. It underpins a wide range of applications, and enhancing theorem-proving capabilities remains a central objective in artificial intelligence [3]. Although recent neuro-symbolic systems have achieved remarkable progress [4-7], their operation is ultimately constrained by classical computational architectures. Quantum computing [8], by contrast, enables information encoding and coherent parallelism beyond classical limits [9-14], raising the possibility of accelerating structured symbolic deduction [15]. Here we report the experimental realization of automated geometry theorem proving on a fully programmable superconducting quantum processor. We develop two complementary quantum proving frameworks. The first implements Wu's algebraic elimination method using quantum pseudo-division, with multivariate polynomials r

translated_title: 在超导量子处理器上证明奥林匹克几何定理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.14533v1 公告类型：交叉  摘要：自动定理证明旨在利用计算系统来证明或反驳数学与逻辑命题[1, 2]。它是广泛应用的基石，而增强定理证明能力仍然是人工智能的核心目标[3]。尽管近期的神经符号系统取得了显著进展[4-7]，但其运行最终受限于经典计算架构。相比之下，量子计算[8]能够实现超越经典极限的信息编码与相干并行性[9-14]，为加速结构化符号推演提供了可能[15]。在本研究中，我们报告了在完全可编程的超导量子处理器上自动化几何定理证明的实验实现。我们开发了两个互补的量子证明框架：第一个框架利用量子伪除法实现了吴氏代数消元方法，以处理多元多项式……
tldr: 该论文首次在完全可编程的超导量子处理器上实验实现了自动化几何定理证明，开发了基于量子伪除法实现吴氏消元法等两个互补的量子证明框架，展示了量子计算加速结构化符号推演的潜力。
en_tdlr: This paper experimentally realizes automated geometry theorem proving on a fully programmable superconducting quantum processor, developing two complementary quantum proving frameworks including Wu's algebraic elimination method via quantum pseudo-division, demonstrating quantum computing's potential to accelerate structured symbolic deduction.
